item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J03190","case1_error":"Treats 70% cheaper as paying 70% of the original price, rather than 30%.","case2_error":"Leading answer 300 conflicts with an otherwise correct derivation yielding 840.","reason":"The first misinterprets a discount; the second has only an answer-marker conflict.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J03191","case1_error":"Incorrectly evaluates the correctly written subtraction 80 − 16 as 40 instead of 64.","case2_error":"Uses the goats-to-sheep ratio as goats' fraction of all animals, miscomputes sheep, and omits the fractions sold.","reason":"The first is a numerical evaluation error; the second introduces incorrect population relations and sale quantities.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03192","case1_error":"Constructs incorrect beavers-per-human and moose-per-human ratios, yielding 361 million instead of 1 million.","case2_error":"No clear error: 8 + one quarter of 8 + 7 correctly gives 17.","reason":"The second solution follows the question's '1/4 more' wording; the reference incorrectly omits the base quantity.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J03193","case1_error":"Uses one bottle's 80-load capacity as the total capacity of two bottles.","case2_error":"Multiplies the first round's eight games by all four rounds, then adds the other rounds again.","reason":"The first omits scaling a per-bottle capacity; the second improperly applies a single round's count across unequal rounds.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03194","case1_error":"Replaces three correctly specified group products with four unsupported addends, summing 32 + 8 + 8 + 64.","case2_error":"Reports an unsupported total of 55.5 after correct revenue formulas; the formulas yield 88.","reason":"The first displays an incorrect aggregation with an extra term; the second provides only an incorrect final number without showing its calculation.","judgment":"different"}]}
